messages:
hannah.sales: Flagging a POC problem with Greenway Financial — their logs show lots of entries with no trace_id in our console, and the forwarder is throwing 403s then 429s. Theyre worried the dashboard is missing telemetry.
devin.ops: Can you paste the exact forwarder output and one sample event?
hannah.sales: Pasted below (sanitized):
```
2026-04-02T08:41:02Z INFO forwarder starting batch=23 size=1.7MB
2026-04-02T08:41:03Z ERROR upload failed status=403 err="AccessDenied: PutObject" attempt=0
2026-04-02T08:41:03Z INFO assume-role arn:aws:iam::333333333333:role/gw-forwarder session=3600
2026-04-02T08:41:05Z INFO retrying upload attempt=1
2026-04-02T08:41:08Z ERROR upload failed status=429 err="TooManyRequests" attempt=1
```
Sample event: `{ "ts":"2026-04-02T08:41:02Z", "level":"info", "message":"request handled", "trace_id":null }`
leo.eng: Pattern is familiar: mid-batch STS rotation -> partial metadata writes -> remaining objects hit ingest ratecap -> joiner can't associate bodies with trace metadata, so trace_id is lost.
rachel-support: One-liner I can send SREs?
hannah.sales: "This is an STS session/permissions timing issue: increase the roles sessionDuration and grant PutObject on the forwarder prefix; as a short-term workaround enable atomic/local buffering in the forwarder."
devin.ops: Suggested forwarder YAML to give them:
```
forwarder:
  buffer_mode: atomic
  fallback_local_buffering: true
  s3_prefix: "greenway/poc/%{env}/"
  aws_sts_session_duration: 43200
  retry:
    max_attempts: 6
```
leo.eng: If they cannot change AWS role settings, alternative options: 1) route uploads through our upload-proxy (enterprise only, slower) 2) enable multipart commit semantics (feature-flag) 3) schedule smaller batch sizes so rotation won't occur mid-batch.
rachel-support: Customers also asked if the 429s are entirely on our side.
quota-bot: [quota] temporary ingest burst granted org=greenway-004 ttl=4h by devin.ops :white_check_mark:
devin.ops: The 429s are ingest throttle for trial plans. I granted a 4h burst while they validate config changes.
infra-bot: [deploy] forwarder v1.14.1 -> rolling canary started 2026-04-02T08:45:00Z :rocket:
hannah.sales: Greenway applied the config change and bumped STS duration. They retried and report trace_id reappeared for the last 3 batches.
leo.eng: Follow-ups: 1) ops to run a duplicate/dedup scan for buffered commits 2) eng to add telemetry to detect "mid-batch credential refresh" and surface clearer error (suggestion: return 409 with hint) 3) sales to add concise KB snippet to POC checklist.
devin.ops: I'll run the duplicate check and post results here in ~25m.
quota-bot: [reminder] ingest burst for greenway-004 expires in 3h 35m  will post a 15m warning before expiry.
rachel-support: Thanks everyone  I'll send the snippet + the one-liner to their SRE and mark this resolved if no issues after duplicate check. :thumbsup:
hannah.sales: Great, appreciate the quick turn.
